requirements.name: Preservation
requirements.acceptance: Baseline source snapshot and exact file inventory; no deletion or forbidden repository/history change.

requirements.name: Policy authority
requirements.acceptance: Deterministic observations preserved; no semantic override or autonomous scientific promotion.

requirements.name: Twelve indicators
requirements.acceptance: All canonical indicators have executable positive/negative, conditional evidence and context acceptance cases.

requirements.name: Context
requirements.acceptance: Quotation, warnings, education, hypotheticals and negation cannot authorize unsupported semantic assertions.

requirements.name: Identity
requirements.acceptance: Independent-reference declarations must be typed, source-linked and assessable; flags alone rejected.

requirements.name: Missingness
requirements.acceptance: Missing content, unsupported modality, absent, abstained and unavailable remain distinct.

requirements.name: NLI score contract
requirements.acceptance: Strict finite normalized three-label scores, logit/token shapes and ties handled.

requirements.name: NLI resources
requirements.acceptance: Pinned local-only explicit initialization; dependency/model failures sanitized without default predictions.

requirements.name: Reproducibility
requirements.acceptance: Codebook/model/hypothesis/preprocessing/policy versions and fingerprints bind source contracts.

requirements.name: Evidence-only input
requirements.acceptance: Explicit consent, language, opaque IDs, bounded source fields and predictor bookkeeping isolation.

requirements.name: Output validation
requirements.acceptance: Malformed, duplicated, forged, inconsistent or unapproved review documents fail closed.

requirements.name: Compatibility safeguards
requirements.acceptance: Executable runtime contract comparison rejects equal-version source/ordering/semantics mismatches and missing declarations.

requirements.name: Reference import
requirements.acceptance: Immutable artifact-bound declared-human response validation; no generated judgments or authenticity claims.

requirements.name: Adjudication
requirements.acceptance: Separate immutable adjudication, strict provenance and binding; no source-response mutation or automatic voting.

requirements.name: Evaluation utilities
requirements.acceptance: Bounded synthetic arithmetic, valid uncertainty interfaces and explicit denominators; no research accuracy evaluation.

requirements.name: Reference separation
requirements.acceptance: Exact supplied record/group separation and immutable evaluation plans; sealed-test execution closed.

requirements.name: Exclusion and admission
requirements.acceptance: Excluded sources rejected at owned boundaries; approvals remain empty and all research stages closed.

requirements.name: Source evidence
requirements.acceptance: All accepted locators match original Unicode fields and eligible source units; no corruption or fabricated support.

requirements.name: No-fit verification
requirements.acceptance: All permitted owned tests/static checks run with explicit restrictions, actual counters, and individual exclusion accounting.

requirements.name: Handoff
requirements.acceptance: Current source-only version comparison, exact changes, traceability, reproducible commands and classified blockers recorded.

requirements.name: Notebook source verification
requirements.acceptance: Verify all five actual notebook guards against an output-free source snapshot without opening protected retained outputs.

requirements.name: External integration acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Obtain a current counterpart runtime declaration and agreed acceptance evidence tied to an authoritative commit; do not infer integration from local fixtures.

scoring: Complete only with reproducible passing evidence. Partial/blocked requirements remain in the denominator. Scientific validation is assessed separately; no percentage inferred from test pass count.
existing_seven_exclusions: Six fitting cases remain prohibited; output-retaining notebooks are absent from this isolated snapshot.
